build_regex_from_object: build a regex from a JSON schema, Pydantic model, or dict using outlines fsm
create_OutlinesGrammarBackend: create an outlines grammar backend with a tokenizer and optional whitespace pattern for constrained decoding
compile_regex_guide: compile a regex string into an OutlinesGrammar guide object for constrained token generation
dispatch_json_schema: dispatch a JSON schema string to build a regex guide for constrained JSON output
fill_vocab_mask: fill a vocabulary mask tensor to restrict token choices based on the current regex guide state
